bead.title: providers: add unit tests for LookupModelLimits + probeProviderFlavor (FEAT-003 AC-06/AC-07)
bead.description:
AR-2026-05-17-repo finding. FEAT-003 AC-06/AC-07 require test coverage for LookupModelLimits (LM Studio, omlx, OpenRouter; explicit config overrides) and probeProviderFlavor (explicit -> URL heuristics -> concurrent probes).

Today only integration tests exist at internal/provider/openai/discovery_integration_test.go:107,129 — they require a live LM Studio/omlx instance and don't run by default. The original 2026-04-17 alignment filed agent-4109aea0 for this; that ID predates the fizeau- ID prefix migration and is unreachable, so re-file under the current namespace.

Source review: fizeau-8e37e536.
bead.acceptance:
1) internal/provider/openai/discovery_test.go (non-integration) contains direct unit tests for LookupModelLimits covering LM Studio, omlx, OpenRouter paths and explicit-config short-circuit, using httptest.Server mocks.
2) discovery_test.go covers probeProviderFlavor with: explicit-config short-circuit, URL-heuristic path (per-provider), and concurrent-probe race resolution.
3) go test ./internal/provider/openai/... -run 'LookupModelLimits|ProbeProviderFlavor' -count=1 green without integration tags.
